title: Mathematics Practice Test 2 - Mathematics - Exponential and Logarithmic Equations
subject: Mathematics

questions.q: The real solution of the equation $3e^x = 12$ is:
questions.explain: Isolate the exponential term by dividing both sides by 3: $e^x = 4$. Next, to solve for the exponent $x$, take the natural logarithm ($\ln$) of both sides. This gives $\ln(e^x) = \ln(4)$, which simplifies by log rules to $x = \ln(4)$.
